مُصَلِّلٌ Copious, or abundant, rain. (IAar, O, K.) ＝
-A2- Also A generous, or noble, and honourable, chief, pure in respect of parentage; as also ↓ مُصَلْصَلٌ , with fet-h: (K:) or one who is pure in respect of generosity, or nobility, and of parentage: (IAar, O:) and ↓ رَجُلٌ مُصَلْصِلٌ [thus in the O] a man who is a generous, or noble, chief, pure in respect of parentage, and honourable. (Ibn-'Abbád, O.) ―
-b2- And The أَسْكَف [or maker of boots]; who is also called by the vulgar [or the people of the towns and village] إِسْكَاف. (IAar, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
